title: Arithmetic fundamental-group exact sequence for geometrically connected schemes over a field
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: One must establish geometric-kernel normality and injectivity as well as surjectivity to the absolute Galois group. The proof descends the Galois orbit of a split component, approximates arbitrary geometric finite etale covers over finite field extensions, and proves the exact-kernel criterion by descending a complete splitting.
